newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-NIGERIAN EBIEDE JAILED FOR INDECENT ASSAULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIGERIAN EBIEDE JAILED FOR INDECENT ASSAULT.

text.p: Nigerian midfielder Emmanuel Ebiede of Belgian club Aalst has been given a one-year jail sentence, mostly suspended, for indecent assault of a 14-year-old girl, a Belgian prosecutor's office said on Tuesday.
"He has been sentenced to 12 months, nine of which suspended, for indecent assault without the use of violence or threats," Dendermonde public prosecutor's office spokesman Tom Lamiroy said.
Ebiede, 19, was arrested in April and accused of having threatened and violently raped the girl, but the Dendermonde court later reduced the charges.
Lamiroy said the prosecutor's office was considering appealing the sentence.
"We feel the re-qualification by the court is not appropriate. It is hard for us to comply," he said.
The club was not immediately available for comment on Ebiede, whose contract expires in two years time.
